title: Sri Lanka Leisure Tour: Kandy, Bentota and the Turtle Hatchery
alt: A hatchling turtle crossing the sand at Kosgoda
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night in the hill capital with the elephants on the way and the lake drive and dance show in the evening.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class beach hotel with a pool facing the sea

activities.name: Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: The hatchery south of Bentota where eggs are protected and hatchlings released into the sea at dusk.

activities.name: Full day Bentota sightseeing
activities.description: The Madu Ganga boat ride, the Kosgoda turtle hatchery, the Galapatha temple and an afternoon on Bentota beach.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with the turtle hatchery on arrival and a full day of the Madu Ganga, the cinnamon island and the sand.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night on the Mount Lavinia beachfront with a full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy
day_titles.2: Down to Bentota and the turtles

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon

2: Breakfast and a transfer from the hills to the coast

Check in at your beach hotel
The evening at leisure on the sand

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Five relaxed days: a night in Kandy with the Pinnawala elephants and the dance show, two on the beach at Bentota with the turtle hatchery and the Madu Ganga, and a final night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; Kandy lake drive and Kandyan dance show; the Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a full day Bentota sightseeing tour; a full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
